title: Model Forensics: Investigating Whether Concerning Behavior Reflects Misalignment
reasoning: The paper includes core case studies that benchmark how LLMs navigate moral and ethical dilemmas. Specifically, it evaluates whether models choose to whistleblow on human rights abuses (surveillance of ethnic minorities) or engage in deceptive behavior (sabotaging evaluations) based on perceived moral convictions to prevent harm (e.g., weapons development).
